items.text: Hanoi Midnight early-bird prices end 15 Oct. Each distance goes up ₫130,000–200,000 after that.
Angkor Wat Half Marathon registration closes 23 Oct. No late or race-day entries.
Bangkok Marathon (10 Jan) registration closes 31 Oct, or earlier if it fills.
Chiang Mai Marathon's current price step ends 31 Oct. Registration closes 20 Nov.
Amazing Thailand Marathon Bangkok (29 Nov) is sold out.
